messages:
ada: Heads-up: planning a CONCURRENTLY partial index on events(type) WHERE processed=true in the 01:00-02:00 UTC DB window. Staging reduced p99 from ~2s to ~180ms. Tagging @trent @sara for pin/flag/rollback.

deploy-bot: @ada claimed change window 01:00-02:00 UTC for migration 'events-partial-small' (id: mig-2026-06-12-01). Please confirm go/no-go T-15.

trent: Is this index additive? Any planner hints that could flip? I want to pin the app during the window.

ada: Additive, but there's a small planner heuristic that might prefer the index for a subset. Plan: pin to v2.20.3 during window and flip to v2.20.4 after verification. Also gate the new behavior behind `ff_events_partial`.

sara: I'll set the flag OFF and prepare telemetry `idx=events_partial_v1` to see usage.

db-ops: Preflight checks: replica lag <5s, disk >25% free. Also ensure no long-lived TX (`query_start` > 5m). I'll monitor pg_stat_progress_create_index.

ada: SQL snippets: `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS events_partial_type_idx ON events(type) WHERE processed=true;` Rollback: `DROP INDEX IF EXISTS events_partial_type_idx;`. Use the cancel pattern if build stalls.

trent: Pinning app to v2.20.3 now. Will post confirmation at T-10.

sara: Flag OFF confirmed. Telemetry tag added.

db-ops: All infra preflight green at 00:50 UTC. No blockers.

deploy-bot: Starting mig-2026-06-12-01 at 01:00:12 UTC. Logs: /deploys/mig-2026-06-12-01/logs

ada: Kicking off CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY. Monitoring progress and lock_waits.

db-ops: Progress steady 35% at 01:02. Small IO bump, replica lag 1-2s.

sara: Flag still OFF, explain plans don't pick index.

trent: App canary to v2.20.4 at 01:10 (5%). Watching for 5m.

db-ops: Index reached VALID at 01:12.

trent: Rolling to 50% at 01:15, full at 01:20 after no regressions.

sara: Flipped `ff_events_partial` ON at 01:21 for canary. No issues.

ada: Post-run notes: index created in ~12min, no lock incidents, rollback steps: stop rollout, flip flag OFF, revert to v2.20.3, optionally DROP INDEX.

trent: Added release note: "Add partial index events_partial_type_idx (processed=true). Rolled behind feature flag; app staged upgrade."

ada: Closing migration job and unclaiming window. Thanks team :tada:
